selection: new low-home trajectories when available; prior validated fallback for missing low-home morphology
object_policy: primary and next meshes use balanced apple/lemon/tomato_soup_can/gelatin_box mapping; 1-3 additional queued YCB/RB objects per station
camera_design: slow front/acceleration for first three grasps; 1.0s final high-speed sweep; short stable wide
queued_object_motion: queued objects follow recorded belt travel for up to 0.32m, then settle; lateral placement centered
queue_collision_policy: non-grasped objects placed upstream with pairwise clearance and centered lateral offsets; belt follow capped for staging
